distillation.title: Distillation
distillation.description: Saving a note checks its tags and links and records unfinished distillation work in the Inbox. Your selected AI reviews related notes together, updates canonical notes, and optimizes links.
distillation.runDescription: Uses your saved AI and model without waiting to gather more notes. Distill unprocessed notes includes pending, failed, and blocked notes. Review all also includes reviewed notes. An active batch finishes before the next one starts.
distillation.runSaveFirst: Save your settings changes before running distillation.
distillation.runAccepted: Request accepted. {{count}} pending notes will be grouped by relevance and distilled in order.
distillation.runAlreadyActive: Distillation is already running. The current processing will continue.
distillation.runNoEligibleNotes: No eligible notes can be run now. If notes still need review, check the reasons in the processing status below.
distillation.enabledDescription: Gather saved notes in the Inbox and process up to 6 related notes together. Gathering waits up to 2 minutes; an active batch may take longer to finish. Failed notes are retained and retried automatically.
distillation.modelsUnavailable: The model list could not be loaded. Refresh it or enter a model ID. Your saved model remains unchanged.
distillation.modelsDescription: Models reported by the AI on this device. Availability also depends on your account.
distillation.effortDescription: Choose how much reasoning this model uses. Supported levels such as Low, High, Max, and Ultra appear here.
distillation.effortChooseModel: Select a model first to choose one of its supported levels.
distillation.effortUnverified: Supported levels for this model are unverified. Refresh the model list.
distillation.effortNotConfigurable: The model CLI did not return selectable reasoning levels.
distillation.effortUnsupported: This model does not support the saved reasoning mode. Choose a supported mode.
distillation.ultraDescription: Codex Ultra distributes work across subagents. It may take longer and use more of your allowance.
distillation.modelDescription: Enter a model supported by the selected AI. The app requests that model; the model actually used also follows the AI provider's restrictions and fallback policies.
distillation.periodicDescription: Previously distilled notes are reviewed again at this interval. The default is 168 hours (one week). New notes and retries do not wait for this interval.
distillation.providerUnavailable: The selected AI executable was not found. Install it, then reopen this screen.
distillation.providerUnsupported: The selected AI's managed configuration is incompatible with automatic distillation. Choose another AI or review the managed configuration.
distillation.authentication: Uses the AI's login on this device. Available models and usage follow that account's settings.
distillation.kbPaused: Paused because KB access is off globally or for the selected AI. You can still save settings.
distillation.notConfigured: Choose an AI, enable automatic distillation, and save your settings.
distillation.paused: Automatic distillation is paused. Unprocessed notes are retained until you resume.
distillation.runningDescription: While kb-app is running, it distills related Inbox notes together, retries failed attempts, and periodically reviews existing notes. Running counts notes, not simultaneous AI calls.

failures.unconfigured: Choose an AI, enable automatic distillation, and save your settings.
failures.kb_disabled: Stopped because KB access is off. Check your KB access settings.
failures.invalid_settings: Check the model identifier, processing time limit, and review interval.
failures.not_installed: The selected AI executable was not found. Check its installation.
failures.unsupported_cli: The selected AI version does not support automatic distillation. Update it or select another AI.
failures.system_policy_conflict: The AI's managed configuration is incompatible with automatic distillation. Choose another AI or review the managed configuration.
failures.guard_outdated: KB protection needs an update. Open KB usage and choose Set up full protection.
failures.guard_unavailable: Paused because full KB protection is unavailable. Check protection status in KB usage.
failures.start_failed: The AI could not start. Check its installation and retry.
failures.timed_out: The processing time limit was reached. Increase the limit if needed, then retry.
failures.cancelled: Interrupted by a settings change or app shutdown. Retry with an active configuration.
failures.output_limit: The AI response exceeded the processing limit. Review the affected content and retry.
failures.process_failed: The AI run failed. Check its login, model access, usage allowance, and network connection.
failures.invalid_response: The AI response did not have the format required for distillation. Retry the attempt.
failures.io: Data exchange with the AI failed. Retry the attempt.
failures.context_limit: An earlier run reached the reference size or review round limit. Retry to identify the cause with the current process.
failures.context_size_limit: The number or total size of referenced documents exceeds the limit. Narrow the set of documents to review.
failures.review_round_limit: The additional review limit was reached, and the collected information was not enough to decide. Review the supporting evidence or related notes.
failures.review_no_progress: Previously completed searches or document requests were repeated without adding evidence. Review the search terms or required sources.
failures.review_not_supported: This note cannot be distilled automatically. Check its classification or whether it requires the dedicated proposal workflow.
failures.review_failed: The distillation result could not be applied. Retry against the latest version; if it continues, check the KB's status.

distillation.recoveryDescription: Unfinished work survives restarts. If notes need attention, check your AI login, model, and KB status, then retry.
distillation.retryQueued: Failed attempts have been queued for retry

timing.title: Execution time breakdown
timing.description: The latest 20 attempts recorded since measurement began. No settings changes are needed. Running durations are estimates as of the last display update. Detecting a forced shutdown may take time.
timing.durationDescription: Total time also includes work between stages. AI calls include CLI startup through receiving and parsing the response; server-side reasoning time is not measured separately. Unmeasured stages are not treated as zero.
timing.empty: No measurements yet. Recording starts with the next distillation attempt. Earlier durations cannot be recovered.
timing.paused: Timing information is hidden while KB use is paused.
timing.unavailable: There is a problem reading or recording measurements. The displayed records may be incomplete or out of date.
timing.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please try again.
timing.inputDescription: Input size is the largest prompt and reference payload sent in an AI call, measured in bytes. Token counts and usage are not measured.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dialogDescription: Manage AI knowledge-base use, automatic distillation, connections, appearance, and startup for this device.
settings.aiGuardReady: Protection and the selected knowledge-base binding are verified. The connections page shows rule output and operation records separately. AI receipt and compliance remain unverified.
settings.aiGuardDevelopment: Development fast mode is active. Codex runs with Full Access, while its MCP and automatic retrieval are disabled to keep it away from the knowledge base. Restore full protection before verification or release.
settings.aiGuardNeeded: Protect raw knowledge-base files from Codex and Claude Code and save the selected knowledge-base binding. Run setup again if an update is needed. Inspect and repair MCP registration on the connections page.
settings.aiGuardConflict: An existing administrator policy conflicts with this guard. It will not be overwritten automatically.
settings.aiGuardInstalled: Protection and automatic retrieval settings saved. Restart your AI apps and reconnect MCP
settings.aiGuardRestartNote: After changing protection or connection settings, restart the affected AI app and reconnect kb-app MCP. Checking settings alone cannot confirm reconnection.
settings.aiGuardDevelopmentEnabled: Development fast mode enabled. Restart Codex. The knowledge base is unavailable from Codex
settings.aiKbEnabled: Use the knowledge base in AI conversations
settings.aiKbOnDescription: Search past knowledge and use it in answers and note updates.
settings.aiKbOffDescription: The AI will not search or update the knowledge base. Saved notes and the management app remain available.
settings.perAppDescription: When the master setting is on, choose which AI apps may use the knowledge base.
settings.clientKbPausedDescription: Paused by the master setting. This per-app preference is still saved.
settings.claudeKbEnabled: Use the knowledge base in Claude
settings.claudeKbOnDescription: Claude can search and update the knowledge base.
settings.claudeKbOffDescription: Claude cannot access the knowledge base.
settings.gptKbEnabled: Use the knowledge base in GPT / Codex
settings.gptKbOnDescription: GPT / Codex can search and update the knowledge base.
settings.gptKbOffDescription: GPT / Codex cannot access the knowledge base.
settings.gptKbOnDone: Knowledge-base use enabled for GPT / Codex
settings.gptKbOffDone: Knowledge-base use disabled for GPT / Codex
settings.aiKbRestartNote: For an accurate comparison, restart the AI app you changed and begin a new conversation. Knowledge already added to a conversation cannot be removed midway.
settings.launchAtLogin: Start automatically when this computer starts
settings.launchAtLoginDescription: Runs in the background without a window, ready to open from the tray icon.
settings.launchAtLoginUnsupported: This operating system cannot register a login item.
settings.note: These settings are stored on this device only (they never go into your notes).
settings.harvestStatusLineDescription: Adds the last 14 days of recorded activity and maintenance status to automatic retrieval. Maintenance details appear only when they change.
